summary: Revision 1 required clarification of exact blocker inventory, enforced path authority and test-write constraints. The claimed write-set gap was rejected after direct receipt verification.

dimensions.rationale: The corrective goal and non-goals are explicit.
Reviewer claimed four mypy paths were missing; direct receipt extraction later disproved the claim.
Commands are constructible and include focused, full and remote checks.
Policy, baselines and authority are immutable.
A separate corrective state avoids rewriting the terminal Release 2.7 run.
One bounded workstream owns the corrective surface.

findings.message: Reviewer claimed the write set omitted four of seven mypy blocker paths.
findings.requiredAction: Rejected as false positive: current validation contains seven mypy paths and all seven are owned; global baseline entries for unchanged paths are not blockers.

findings.message: Prove policy and baseline immutability through enforced ownership, not declarations alone.
findings.requiredAction: Revision 2 requires ownership and implementation-audit receipts and blocks every non-task-owned path.

findings.message: Writable tests must not allow assertions to be weakened.
findings.requiredAction: Revision 2 permits only added or tightened coverage and retains stable expected outputs.
